mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent (id, name, avatar, description, system_prompt, welcome_message, provider, model_id, temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens, tools_json, enabled, user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{description}, #{systemPrompt}, #{welcomeMessage}, #{provider}, #{modelId}, #{temperature}, #{topP}, #{topK}, #{maxTokens}, #{toolsJson}, #{enabled}, #{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent SET name = #{name}, avatar = #{avatar}, description = #{description}, system_prompt = #{systemPrompt}, welcome_message = #{welcomeMessage}, provider = #{provider}, model_id = #{modelId}, temperature = #{temperature}, top_p = #{topP}, top_k = #{topK}, max_tokens = #{maxTokens}, tools_json = #{toolsJson}, enabled = #{enabled}, user_id = #{userId}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, avatar, description, system_prompt, welcome_message, provider, model_id, temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens, tools_json, enabled, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, avatar, description, system_prompt, welcome_message, provider, model_id, temperature, top_p, top_k, max_tokens, tools_json, enabled, user_id, created_at, updated_at FROM agent WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
